I need to decide on an auction bid for North Carolina Avenue.

I have $726 and a strong pink monopoly. The opponent has a dangerous dark blue monopoly with Boardwalk and Park Place. Player 3 is bankrupt.

Player 4 has $763 and a light blue monopoly. The auction is at $53 with p2 and p4 bidding. I should cap the bid near $150 to mortgage North Carolina Avenue back and hold the green block for free.

Boardwalk with 4 houses pays $1400. Park Place with 3 houses pays $1100. The dark blue monopoly is extremely dangerous. I am currently on the mortgaged green Pennsylvania Avenue.

If I win the auction, neither opponent can complete the green monopoly without trading with me. If p4 wins, they still need Pacific from p1 to finish the set and cannot build without it.

Player 4 is in jail and has $763, so they can afford to bid for North Carolina Avenue. They likely want the second green property to trade with player 1 for Pacific or simply block me from completing the set. Player 1 has only $29 cash but a lethal dark blue monopoly.

The pink monopoly pays $750 on St. Charles and States, and $900 on Virginia with four houses each. No houses remain in the bank, so no player can build more houses until someone sells or upgrades to hotels. I have twelve houses on the pinks, but upgrading to hotels would require purchasing them since the bank holds only twelve hotels.
